\section[vidyālayaḥ]{\sk{विद्यालयः} (vidyālayaḥ) — a school}

\label{lesson:SA-C83-school}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Sanskrit for an island, then the Sanskrit for a shore.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \sk{विद्यालयः}}
\textbf{\sk{विद्यालयः}} (\emph{vidyālayaḥ}) — \textquotedblleft{}a school\textquotedblright{}: \textbf{\sk{विद्या}}, \textquotedblleft{}knowledge\textquotedblright{}, with \textbf{\sk{आलयः}}, \textquotedblleft{}home\textquotedblright{}. A school is a home of knowledge.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
Knowledge plus home.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{vidyālayaḥ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{vidyālayaḥ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{vidyālayaḥ}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Sanskrit for an island, then the Sanskrit for a shore, then say \emph{vidyālayaḥ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \sk{विद्यालयः} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A school\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
